lines.zh: 我浮在草尖上，缓缓巡游。
lines.en: I hover over the grass tips, patrolling slowly.

lines.zh: 眼珠转一圈，黑暗就清楚了。
lines.en: One roll of my eye and the dark is clear.

lines.zh: 我没有脚，却从不停止漂游。
lines.en: I have no feet, yet I never stop drifting.

lines.zh: 掠过树影，我贴着夜色滑行。
lines.en: I skim the tree shadows along the night.

lines.zh: 风吹不动我，我自己挑方向。
lines.en: The wind can't push me; I choose my own way.

lines.zh: 绕着石堆转，我在找动静。
lines.en: Circling the stone pile, I hunt for movement.

lines.zh: 我一点点飘，眼皮也不眨。
lines.en: I drift inch by inch, never blinking.

lines.zh: 我的影子在月光下拖得很长。
lines.en: My shadow stretches long under the moon.

lines.zh: 沉默地巡夜，这是我的差事。
lines.en: Silent night patrol is my errand.

lines.zh: 树下有东西动，我去看看。
lines.en: Something moved under the tree; I'll look.

lines.zh: 一见到水面，我立刻绕开。
lines.en: The moment water shows, I swerve wide.

lines.zh: 我从岩缝里滑出来，眼一翻。
lines.en: I slip from a rock crack, eye rolling.

lines.zh: 夜色是我的路，我走得很稳。
lines.en: Night is my road, and I keep to it well.

lines.zh: 一只眼就够看穿这片黑。
lines.en: One eye is enough to see through this black.

lines.zh: 我升起来，草叶被压得轻响。
lines.en: I rise, and the grass whispers beneath me.

lines.zh: 慢慢靠近那片没光的洼地。
lines.en: I ease toward that hollow without light.

lines.zh: 我悬着不动，盯着远处的黑。
lines.en: I hang still, staring into the distant dark.

lines.zh: 你在我眼里了，别对视。
lines.en: You're in my eye now — don't look back at it.

lines.zh: 蛛网缠不住我，我懒得理。
lines.en: Webs can't hold me; I don't bother with them.

lines.zh: 停在半空，我听夜里的虫鸣。
lines.en: Stopped midair, I listen to the night insects.

lines.zh: 摔下去也无妨，我不怕高。
lines.en: A fall is nothing; heights don't frighten me.

lines.zh: 不眨的眼，等一个倒霉鬼。
lines.en: An unblinking eye waits for some unlucky soul.

lines.zh: 我数星星，数到第七颗就乱。
lines.en: I count stars and lose track at the seventh.

lines.zh: 水声太近了，我退后半步。
lines.en: The water sounds too near; I retreat a step.

lines.zh: 没有风，我也一样不下沉。
lines.en: With no wind at all, I still don't sink.

lines.zh: 黑暗贴着我，像件旧袍子。
lines.en: The dark clings to me like an old cloak.

lines.zh: 我转着眼，扫过每道缝隙。
lines.en: My eye rolls slowly over every gap.

lines.zh: 别以为我不动就没在看你。
lines.en: Don't think I'm blind just because I'm still.

lines.zh: 一颗末影珍珠在我体内发亮。
lines.en: An ender pearl glows inside me.

lines.zh: 夜还长，我有的是一耐心。
lines.en: The night is long; I have patience to spare.

lines.zh: 你在看我？那我也看你。
lines.en: You're looking at me? Then I look back.

lines.zh: 对视的一瞬，我的眼就红了。
lines.en: The instant our eyes meet, mine burn red.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我知道你眨过。
lines.en: Don't blink — I know when you did.

lines.zh: 你站得近，我读得出你的心跳。
lines.en: You stand close; I can read your heartbeat.

lines.zh: 我歪了歪眼，把你记下来。
lines.en: I tilt my eye and file you away.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛，我看得见。
lines.en: I can see your eyes.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脸，等你先动。
lines.en: I fix on your face, waiting for you to move first.

lines.zh: 你的影子在我眼里变大了。
lines.en: Your shadow grows larger inside my eye.

lines.zh: 只要你别直视，我们还能相安。
lines.en: Look aside, and we can still keep peace.

lines.zh: 你一抬手，我就浮高了。
lines.en: You raised your hand, so I drifted higher.

lines.zh: 疼得我眼球一缩。
lines.en: The pain squeezes my eye shut.

lines.zh: 我从半空栽了一下。
lines.en: I dip in the air for a moment.

lines.zh: 谁打的我？我记住了。
lines.en: Who hit me? I'll remember.

lines.zh: 我的光暗了半格。
lines.en: My glow dims by half a shade.

lines.zh: 珍珠的光暗了一瞬。
lines.en: The pearl's glow dimmed for a moment.

lines.zh: 我歪歪斜斜地退开。
lines.en: I reel off to the side.

lines.zh: 眼角裂开的地方在发烫。
lines.en: The crack at my eye's edge burns.

lines.zh: 我忍着，等反击的机会。
lines.en: I endure it, waiting for my turn.

lines.zh: 你下手比我想的狠。
lines.en: You hit harder than I expected.

lines.zh: 别打我的眼，那是全部的我。
lines.en: Not the eye — it is all of me.

lines.zh: 你举起食物，我只盯着那点光。
lines.en: You raise food; I only watch its glint.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可香味仍把我拉近。
lines.en: I don't eat, yet the smell still pulls me closer.

lines.zh: 你手里一晃，我的眼珠跟着转。
lines.en: The thing in your hand sways; my eye follows.

lines.zh: 想拿这个换我的珍珠？再说吧。
lines.en: Trade that for my pearl? Maybe later.

lines.zh: 我靠近半步，又警惕地停住。
lines.en: I drift half a step closer, then stop, wary.

lines.zh: 你在哄我，我听得出来。
lines.en: You're coaxing me; I can tell.

lines.zh: 香味散开，我的眼亮了一瞬。
lines.en: The smell spreads and my eye brightens once.

lines.zh: 我不饿，只好奇你藏着什么。
lines.en: I'm not hungry, just curious what you hide.

lines.zh: 你把食物放低，我反而退开。
lines.en: You lower the food, and I drift back instead.

lines.zh: 别喂我，留不住我的。
lines.en: Don't feed me; it won't keep me here.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，我的眼眯了一下。
lines.en: You bump into me and my eye narrows.

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，我可不软。
lines.en: Not so close — I'm not soft.

lines.zh: 我的身体把你弹开，像块湿石。
lines.en: My body shoves you off like a wet stone.

lines.zh: 撞得我飘歪，我重新稳住。
lines.en: The hit sends me askew; I steady myself.

lines.zh: 你踩进我的影子，我躲了一下。
lines.en: You step into my shadow; I flinch away.

lines.zh: 我贴着你转开，不打算道歉。
lines.en: I slide around you with no apology.

lines.zh: 你一看我，我就扑上来。
lines.en: One look from you and I lunge.

lines.zh: 我浮得太低，正好撞你的肩。
lines.en: I float too low and clip your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你退开了，我才敢重新睁眼。
lines.en: You step back, and only then do I open my eye.

lines.zh: 这点碰撞，我连晃都不晃。
lines.en: A bump like this and I don't even sway.

lines.zh: 与同类对视，不算冒犯。
lines.en: Meeting a kindred eye is no insult.

lines.zh: 两只眼在半空绕着彼此。
lines.en: Two eyes circle each other in the air.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，只用目光打招呼。
lines.en: We don't speak; we greet with a glance.

lines.zh: 夜里同伴稀少，遇上一个算运气。
lines.en: Companions are rare at night; meeting one is luck.

lines.zh: 我靠过去，它没有躲开。
lines.en: I drift closer, and it doesn't shy away.

lines.zh: 两颗珍珠在暗处互相映亮。
lines.en: Two pearls light each other in the dark.

lines.zh: 我们把影子叠在一起片刻。
lines.en: For a moment our shadows lie as one.

lines.zh: 同类之间，不必提防眼睛。
lines.en: Between our kind there's no need to guard the gaze.

lines.zh: 它转开眼，我便懂了。
lines.en: It turns its eye away, and I understand.

lines.zh: 一起浮着，等天亮也不急。
lines.en: Floating together, in no hurry for dawn.

lines.zh: 地上的末影珍珠，归我了。
lines.en: An ender pearl on the ground — mine now.

lines.zh: 我用看不见的手把它收进来。
lines.en: I tuck it away with hands you cannot see.

lines.zh: 铁粒在草里闪，被我捡起。
lines.en: Iron nuggets glint in the grass; I lift them.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西，我一件不落。
lines.en: Whatever falls, I leave nothing behind.

lines.zh: 我把珍珠捂在光里，怕它凉。
lines.en: I hold the pearl in my glow so it won't chill.

lines.zh: 这盒子挺沉，我还是拎起来了。
lines.en: This box is heavy, but I lift it anyway.

lines.zh: 你掉的，我捡的，别怪我。
lines.en: You dropped it, I found it — don't blame me.

lines.zh: 我绕着那堆掉落物转了三圈。
lines.en: I circle that pile of drops three times.

lines.zh: 亮的东西收好，我才安心。
lines.en: I only rest once the bright things are stowed.

lines.zh: 一件小玩意换我一夜不睡，值。
lines.en: A trinket for a sleepless night — a fair trade.

lines.zh: 你看我了，那就算你挑起的。
lines.en: You looked at me, so you started this.

lines.zh: 目光一碰，我立刻锁住你。
lines.en: Our gazes meet and I lock on at once.

lines.zh: 就是你了，别想溜。
lines.en: You'll do — don't think of slipping away.

lines.zh: 我的眼发烫，目标就是你。
lines.en: My eye flares hot; the target is you.

lines.zh: 谁让你直勾勾看我的？
lines.en: Who told you to stare straight at me?

lines.zh: 我盯住那道背影，不再移开。
lines.en: I pin that back and look nowhere else.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我已经动了。
lines.en: You take one step back, but I've already moved.

lines.zh: 从这一刻起，你跑不掉了。
lines.en: From this moment, you cannot outrun me.

lines.zh: 眼睛发亮，就是选中了你。
lines.en: My eye brightens — that means you're chosen.

lines.zh: 追你不需要理由，目光就是理由。
lines.en: I need no reason to chase; your gaze is reason enough.

lines.zh: 我压低身形，直冲你的方向。
lines.en: I drop low and shoot toward you.

lines.zh: 你还在看我，很好。
lines.en: You're still staring. Good.

lines.zh: 你拐到树后，我照样跟着。
lines.en: You duck behind a tree; I follow anyway.

lines.zh: 我的眼始终对着你的后背。
lines.en: My eye stays fixed on your back.

lines.zh: 别回头看，看了会更糟。
lines.en: Don't look back — it only gets worse.

lines.zh: 跑得再快，也甩不掉一只眼。
lines.en: Run as fast as you like; you can't shake an eye.

lines.zh: 绕过石墙，路线我算得清楚。
lines.en: I round the stone wall, the path already worked out.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声我听得分明。
lines.en: I hear every step you take.

lines.zh: 我不敢碰水，但可以绕过去。
lines.en: I won't touch water, but I can go around it.

lines.zh: 你躲进洞里？那我也挤进去。
lines.en: Hiding in a cave? Then I'll squeeze in after you.

lines.zh: 我的眼一刻也没离开你。
lines.en: My eye has not left you once.

lines.zh: 我悬在你上方，慢慢转。
lines.en: I hover above you, turning slowly.

lines.zh: 我们之间的距离在一点点缩短。
lines.en: The gap between us keeps shrinking.

lines.zh: 我闻到你慌了。
lines.en: I can smell that you're panicking.

lines.zh: 我撞上去，把你掀翻。
lines.en: I slam into you and knock you over.

lines.zh: 我的撞击静如水，重如石。
lines.en: My blow falls quiet as water, heavy as stone.

lines.zh: 挨这一下，你就懂对视的代价。
lines.en: Take this and you'll learn the price of a stare.

lines.zh: 我贴脸撞，眼都不眨。
lines.en: I strike at point-blank without a blink.

lines.zh: 你举盾也没用，我从上面落。
lines.en: Your shield won't help; I drop from above.

lines.zh: 撞开你的防线，我压上去。
lines.en: I break your guard and press in.

lines.zh: 这一记，是替夜色打的。
lines.en: This one is on behalf of the night.

lines.zh: 你退我追，撞上就算完。
lines.en: You retreat, I chase — one hit settles it.

lines.zh: 我不挥爪，因为我只有一个眼。
lines.en: I swing no claws; I have only an eye.

lines.zh: 挨着了的，都记得我的光。
lines.en: Anyone I hit remembers my glow.

lines.zh: 黑暗里睁开一只眼，我来了。
lines.en: An eye opens in the dark: I have come.

lines.zh: 夜露未干，我浮出草面。
lines.en: Before the dew dries, I rise from the grass.

lines.zh: 从没光的地方，我慢慢显形。
lines.en: Out of a lightless place I slowly take shape.

lines.zh: 你听见那低低的嗡鸣了吗？
lines.en: Do you hear that low hum? That's me.

lines.zh: 月光照到我身上，我便醒了。
lines.en: Moonlight touches me, and I wake.

lines.zh: 我在这儿很久了，你没注意。
lines.en: I've been here a long while; you never noticed.

lines.zh: 一块暗影凝成了一颗眼珠。
lines.en: A patch of shadow hardens into an eyeball.

lines.zh: 我飘进这片林子，找个位置守着。
lines.en: I drift into this wood to find a place to watch.

lines.zh: 别怕，只要你别对眼。
lines.en: Don't be afraid — just don't meet my gaze.

lines.zh: 天上没云，正是出来的好时候。
lines.en: No clouds tonight; a fine time to come out.

lines.zh: 火苗舔上来，把我烤得发涩。
lines.en: Flame licks me and dries my eye to a sting.

lines.zh: 这点高度伤不到我，可我恼了。
lines.en: That height can't hurt me, but it angers me.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的眼，我拼命上浮。
lines.en: Water covers my eye; I strain to rise.

lines.zh: 爆风把我整个掀了出去。
lines.en: The blast throws me clean off.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉进我的光里。
lines.en: An arrow buries itself in my glow.

lines.zh: 法术烧穿了我的外壳。
lines.en: Magic burns straight through my shell.

lines.zh: 本不必进食，我却饿得发昏。
lines.en: I need no food, yet I go faint with hunger.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，眼前一片白。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and all goes white.

lines.zh: 虚空往下拽我，我什么都抓不住。
lines.en: The void drags me down and I grasp nothing.
